reviews.text: My Beauceron mix was pampered for four days and four nights. She had so much fun at this doggy colony that she's been resting non-stop since I got back. You're dealing with passionate, patient people who truly understand canine behavior. Leave with peace of mind and give your furry friend the best vacation ever!

Fantastic experience at Oscar and Friends' place. Lucky was thrilled with his one-night stay. Thanks to Melanie and David for this amazing experience. I was able to follow Lucky's stay through photos, which was fantastic!!

My dog ​​is very stressed and can't stand being left alone at home. Since we met Mélanie and David, we finally have a solution for when we have to be away. 🥰 She's always happy to go to their place and we can see that she feels comfortable there. It's incredibly reassuring to know that she's in good hands and that she's having a good time while we're gone.
Thank you so much, Mélanie and David, for taking such good care of her ❤️

My dog ​​was happy throughout his 4-day stay. I regularly received videos and photos. They even sleep with the air conditioning on when needed and are always supervised. Games are organized. Their knowledge of animal behavior is evident, Mélanie and David also offer excellent advice, and the dogs are pampered. It's more than just a concierge service; it's a hotel and a playground all in one. I highly recommend it.

I entrusted my two Australian Shepherds to Mélanie and David for two days, and I never imagined my dogs would be so well cared for! The welcome was fantastic, Mélanie sent me all the photos and videos, and picking up my dogs was wonderful... I was hesitant at first, but I could see how happy my dogs were! I would definitely go back without hesitation, and I thank her again!

Aska, our energetic border collie, spent three days at Mélanie's surrounded by friends. Daily walks, mud baths, and spa time upon our return 🤣 Lots of photos and videos were sent while we were away, which was very reassuring.
Finally, a pet sitter in Marseille! Highly recommended! …

I'm Billy's mom and I was so happy to meet Mélanie and David and their two dogs... It was truly a wonderful experience, and my dog ​​was showered with cuddles and attention that went beyond what I could have hoped for 🙏 During his eight days there was an atmosphere full of love and harmony 💗 I wholeheartedly recommend Oscar and his friends

Nepal, my setter/griffon mix, was pampered for a week in August at Oscar and his friends' place. Not only did he play with his friends, he slept wherever he wanted, he was cuddled, in short, he was the happiest dog. I recommend it 1000%.

Our Australian Shepherd was cared for professionally, kindly, and efficiently for three days. A huge thank you to Mélanie and David for their gentleness. We highly recommend them and will entrust our dog to them again whenever needed.

I highly recommend this dog-sitting service! 🐶

We entrusted our 8-month-old puppy to Mélanie and David for the whole day, and everything went wonderfully. He had a blast all day, and we received regular updates and photos, which was really reassuring.

Between his friends, treats, little ice creams, and especially lots of cuddles, let's just say he had a better day than we did! 😂

It's clear that Mélanie and David truly love dogs and take excellent care of them. We wouldn't hesitate to entrust our pup to them again. Thanks again! 🐾
The team is attentive to both owners and dogs. I recommend them.
Excellent concierge service, professional and attentive staff, a real pleasure to entrust my dog ​​to David and Mélanie!

An excellent dog-sitting service!
The staff are serious, caring, and very professional. Dogs are welcomed into a pleasant environment and receive excellent care.
I highly recommend them!
